versions.changelog:
paper-code-html v1.0.0

- Initial release of the "论文与代码深度解析" skill.
- Generates well-structured, academic-style HTML reports analyzing both research papers and their corresponding code.
- Supports full workflow: information collection, path and security validation, deep analysis of paper and code, and structured HTML output.
- Requires and integrates with the frontend-design skill for high-quality HTML presentation; fallback to simple HTML if unavailable (with user confirmation).
- Includes thorough path checks, user prompts for special analysis needs, and customizable output options.
